description: Live + History Signal Overlay - Add a unified ChartSignal model combining LIT X / TRADEPRO / SMT signals, a signal history composable panel, and draw live vs history signals on the chart with different opacities.
steps: Create domain/model/ChartSignal.kt: data class ChartSignal(id: String, source: SignalSource, direction: Direction, entry: Double, sl: Double, tp: Double, barIndex: Int, timestamp: Long, confidence: Double, isLive: Boolean) and enum class SignalSource { LITX, TRADEPRO, SMT }
Add signals: List<ChartSignal> = emptyList() to ChartUiState and showSignalHistory: Boolean = false

In ChartViewModel, maintain computed signals list from the latest litXAnalysis + tradeProAnalysis + smtDivergences. Mark the most recent of each source as isLive=true, older as isLive=false. Add functions: toggleSignalHistory(), computeSignals()

Create feature/chart/presentation/ChartSignalHistory.kt - a composable showing a scrollable list of past signals (reuse the LitXSignalCard pattern from feature/litx/presentation/components/LitXSignalCard.kt), toggled via a button/expandable panel at the bottom of ChartScreen
Update ChartSignalLayer.kt (from FEAT-003) to draw live signals with full opacity (alpha=0.9) and history signals as faded markers (alpha=0.3)
Add a signal-history toggle button to ChartScreen (e.g. a small FAB or toolbar icon) that shows/hides the ChartSignalHistory panel
acceptance_criteria: ChartSignal.kt and SignalSource enum exist in domain/model/ with correct fields
ChartUiState has signals and showSignalHistory fields
ChartViewModel computes a unified signal list from LitX, TradePro, and SMT analyses
ChartSignalHistory composable displays signals in a scrollable list with signal source badge and direction color
ChartSignalLayer draws live signals at full opacity and history signals faded
Signal history panel is toggleable from ChartScreen
verification: Source-level verification: confirm ChartSignal model, signals computation in ViewModel, ChartSignalHistory composable, and opacity differentiation in ChartSignalLayer
